description: Drinking Water Sources - Source Areas is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Watershed Stewardship and Security. Polygon features representing the geographical extent of a source area that contributes water to a drinking water system. A drinking water system is any domestic system servicing anything other than a single-family dwelling, as defined in the Drinking Water Protection Act. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Watershed Stewardship and Security. Its tags are Drinking water, Protection, Source Area, Source water, Water. It offers 5 resource(s) in ARCGIS_REST, KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
